attributes.short_description: Start a new Convex app or add Convex to an existing frontend

core_principles.correctness_first: TypeScript with end-to-end types, tsc catches mistakes before deploy
core_principles.transactional_integrity: Every query and mutation is automatically a serializable transaction
core_principles.prototype_to_production: Same code scales without rewrite, zero infra configuration
core_principles.component_ecosystem: Drop-in components add whole subsystems in one install

attributes.design_rationale: Human keeps merge button because no credible system ships unattended prod auto-merge - this matches industry boundary for automated deployment
attributes.certification_rationale: Must certify before proposing because uncertain fix is worse than open, visible error
attributes.triage_rationale: Transient blips don't need PRs, config errors go to env (never guess secrets), only real code/schema defects enter repair loop

attributes.rationale: Green typecheck proves code parses, not that non-owner is denied or query returns right rows. Happy-path demo never catches authz defects - the #1 real bug in 30-app corpus is authorization holes
attributes.key_insight: Failing negative assertion is real authz hole found before ship - don't weaken test to make it pass
